resources.string: The microphone hears nothing. Is it muted?
Phone microphone (the headset did not respond)
Dictation needs Offline Speech to Text
A free app that turns speech into text right on the phone, without internet. Install it, open it once to download a speech model, then tap the mic again.
Offline Speech to Text isn\'t ready
It\'s installed, but the keyboard can\'t reach its speech service. Update it from Zapstore, or check that it isn\'t turned off.
Offline Speech to Text has no speech model yet
Open it, download a model, then tap the mic again.
Offline Speech to Text is missing a permission
Open it, allow what it asks for, then tap the mic again.
Under Permissions, allow the microphone for Droneboard.
